Government May Refer FCRA Bill to Joint Parliamentary Committee Amid Opposition

The Indian government is reportedly considering sending the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2023, to a Joint Parliamentary Committee (JPC) for further scrutiny. This move comes amid significant opposition pushback and demands for the bill's complete withdrawal from parties like Congress and TMC. Some reports suggest a potential "trade-off" involving the bill's referral. In Tamil Nadu, the state government has moved a resolution against the FCRA Bill. Opposition leader Dimple Yadav questioned the source of funding for the RSS in relation to the bill.
